title: NoNetheriteUpgrade
description: Completely disables Netherite upgrades by removing the upgrade item.
body:
NoNetheriteUpgrade is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that completely removes the Netherite Upgrade item from the game.

What it does:
Prevents the Netherite Upgrade item from spawning in the world
Cancels the item if a player tries to drop it or move it in their inventory
Blocks any use of the item, effectively disabling all Netherite upgrades
Features:
Easy to install and use
Compatible with Minecraft 1.20+
Ensures fair gameplay by removing the ability to upgrade items to Netherite

This plugin is perfect for servers that want to disable Netherite upgrades without affecting other gameplay mechanics.
